description: Platform overview: hosts, services, Kubernetes, GPU, traffic and data services. Red or yellow tiles at the top mean something needs a person.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: node-exporter up per host. NO DATA = the target is not scraped at all (Rancher today).

panels.title: Services
panels.description: 1 = up. K8s is the minimum Ready flag across nodes.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets with up == 0.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts in firing state.

panels.title: Pod problems
panels.description: Failed pods plus containers stuck in CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff or ErrImagePull.

panels.title: Deployments not ready
panels.description: Deployments with fewer available replicas than desired.

panels.title: GPUs online
panels.description: GPUs reporting DCGM metrics.

panels.title: Fullest filesystem
panels.description: Highest usage across every real mount, including /boot. The old Disk panel only looked at /.

panels.title: Load per core (1m)
panels.description: Load divided by core count. Above 1.0 means runnable processes outnumber cores. Replaces the raw load panel, which needed the core counts typed into its description.

panels.title: Fullest mounts (now)
panels.description: Every real mount per host, fullest first. /boot is included on purpose: a full /boot blocks kernel updates.

panels.title: VRAM used %
panels.description: Replaces the 0/1 active-idle panel: it shows how full each GPU actually is.

panels.title: VRAM used / free
panels.description: DCGM reports MiB; converted to bytes. H200 is about 141 GB.

panels.title: GPU power
panels.description: Split from temperature: the two shared one axis before.

panels.title: Container restarts (last 1h) by namespace
panels.description: Namespaces whose containers restarted in the last hour.

panels.title: Requests per second by path
panels.description: Real requests per second reaching Traefik, health checks filtered out. High is normal traffic, not a fault.

panels.title: HTTP error rate
panels.description: 4xx includes scanner 404s and is normal. 5xx is our own errors and should stay at 0%.

panels.title: Response latency
panels.description: LLM chat streams, so thousands of ms is normal. Non-LLM p50 should stay under about 100 ms.

panels.title: Milvus collections
panels.description: Collections in Milvus PROD.

panels.title: Milvus stored rows
panels.description: Total vectors across all collections.

panels.title: MinIO bucket size
panels.description: Milvus object storage (files-server-vector-database).

panels.title: MinIO objects
panels.description: Objects in the MinIO bucket.

panels.title: Milvus disk (/)
panels.description: Root disk of the Milvus PROD node. Above 90% needs more capacity.

panels.title: PostgreSQL connections
panels.description: Active connections. max_connections is 100; above 80 needs attention.

panels.title: PostgreSQL databases
panels.description: Every database on the lab-host PostgreSQL: size and connections.
